description: Restore device state to before a write, identified by its journal ID. RouterOS: reads the before-snapshot, diffs against live state, and applies the reverse. SwOS: re-POSTs the exact pre-write '.b' blob. Use dryRun=true to preview. Requires MIKROMCP_DATA_DIR (defaults to data/).

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dryRun.description: Preview the restore plan without applying changes

journalId.description: Journal entry ID from write-journal.ndjson to roll back

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: rollback_change
title: Rollback Change
